purpose: Test whether the overall pose change alone is sufficient to reproduce the rc8b 4202 sustained sliding. It cannot separate hidden contact/stress/velocity contributions.

rollout_identity.note: a5_recovery.py, a5_capture.py, pfs1_observation_v2.py, stage4_success_v1.py and assets are byte-identical to rc8b; only the registered initial and diagnostic orchestration change

physics_scope.expert_control: unchanged; targets recomputed from the observed state

loaded_state.final: transformed old folded geometry at the new overall pose

diagnostic_initial.note: derived control; not valid for formal batches or the seven-case matrix

interpretation.reproduce_sliding: overall pose change is sufficient in this case; does not identify the release contact mechanism
interpretation.old_behavior: the rigid transform is insufficient; inspect remaining geometry, loaded state and repeatability; do not claim hidden stress is the cause
interpretation.intermediate: record continuous metrics; do not force a binary conclusion

boundaries: one 4202 single only; no retry, no expansion, no freeze
not part of the seven-case matrix; rc8b failure preserved
